title: Lecturer in Public Policy
bio: Lauren Brodsky is the Senior Director of the HKS Communications Program and a Lecturer in Public Policy. She teaches courses on policy writing and persuasive communications, and is the Faculty Chair of the executive education program, “Persuasive Communication: Narrative, Evidence, Impact.”
